title: US Privacy string in buildVideoUrl
body:
## Type of issue

This is a feature request:

Google expects that the ccpa privacy string is added to their ads url ( see [here](https://developers.google.com/interactive-media-ads/docs/sdks/html5/client-side/ccpa) ).

Ideally, prebid would use the privacy string provided by the usp module and insert it automatically.
author: Participant 1
